newsitem.title: USA: Scotsman to acquire most of Kysor - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Scotsman to acquire most of Kysor - WSJ.

text.p: Scotsman Industries Inc has agreed to acquire most of Kysor Industrial for about $300 million, the Wall Street Journal said Monday.
Citing people familiar with the deal, the report said Scotsman would offer $43 for each Kysor common and preferred share.
The report said the move would nearly double Scotsman's revenue base and broaden the company's refrigeration-equipment business.
Kysor also is expected to sell assets of its transportation products group to Kuhlman Corp for $86 million and the assumption of certain liabilities, the report said.
The report said the directors of Scotsman, Kysor and Kuhlman approved the deal over the weekend.
